findings.title: Explicit named reference missing from the raw reference indexes
affected_criteria: Independently inventory both columns and every heading, clause/list item, note, exception, example, diagram/counter component, table/legend and editorial region on physical pages 9-12; pin complete reading order, explicit geometric/content gaps and raw cross-chapter references.
findings.observation: The original page visibly refers to the Stacking rules. The pinned raw text retains this wording, but the explicit reference list is empty and the unfollowed-reference report has no entry for this region. Other named table/chart references are explicitly indexed.
findings.consequence: The task requires raw cross-chapter references to be pinned. A consumer of the supplied reference indexes loses this explicit unresolved dependency even though the text bytes remain available. This is an indexing omission, not a missing source region or a gameplay ruling.
findings.required_repair: In a fresh owned repair attempt, retain the literal named reference Stacking rules in this region raw_cross_references and the corresponding continuations unfollowed_references entry. Audit the already assigned pages for the same explicit named-reference omission. Do not infer a section number, resolve meaning, or follow the citation outside physical pages 9-12. Freeze changed reports and a new manifest/delivery envelope; preserve this delivery and all accepted/blocked bytes.
repair_validation: Check the exact region ID/key and original page-11 wording against the repaired raw reference and unfollowed-reference records.

Verify every changed report hash and new envelope; preserve all 135 region IDs, boxes, evidence locators, full/task/context counts, prior accepted scope, complete ledger/order and all four literal continuations.

Re-run required named validations with unchanged tools/tests and approved permissions where needed. Re-review changed material and affected reference-index risks against the preserved complete source review.
